name: dsh-guava-pack
description: One portable DSH bundle: phone UI, direct/SSR provider router, theme manager, a customized Cyberpunk 2077 theme, an OpenCode session-header fix, a model-driven context-compaction backend (ACP), plus the CommandCode bridge service. Install once, works anywhere.

scripts.test: node tools/tests/model-policy.mjs && node tools/tests/web-search-switch.mjs && node tools/tests/provider-router-adaptive.mjs && node tools/tests/context-guard-trigger.mjs && node tools/gen-acp-preset.mjs --check && node tools/tests/acp-engine.mjs && node tools/tests/acp-ledger.mjs && node tools/tests/acp-nudge.mjs && node tools/tests/acp-mount.mjs && node tools/tests/acp-e2e.mjs --strict && node tools/tests/acp-client.mjs
